haiku.problem: The question says Rebekah asked the LORD why her children struggled. Verse 22 has her say "Why is this happening to me?" and then go to inquire of the LORD, so she did not put that question to Him.

Isaac's prayer is a minor detail. A card about the older serving the younger (1-7), which is God's key declaration, or Esau despising his birthright (2-14), which is the passage's point, is clearly more important and was left out.
